[Intro]
[C]

[Verse 1]
[C]Been gone a long time
I kinda lost my way, I can't find it
And I caught a short ride
To the grave and back this season
I can try to get by
But every time I start to panic
I'm a little bit shy
A bit strange and a little bit manic

[Pre Chorus]

[C]La da da [Dm]da, da da da da da

[Chorus]
[C]I went to a wishing
[G]well, but sank to the ocean
[Am]floor Cut up by sharpened
[F]rocks, and washed up along the
[C]shore I reached for a shooting
[G]star, it burned a hole through my
[Am]hand Made it's way through my
[F]heart, had fun in the promise

[Interlude]
[C]land

[Verse 2]
[C]On the narrowing line,
what a way to sort my troubles
In a very short time,
gonna pop, better duck and cover
Can you figure me out?
I got caught like a little kid stealing
Did I say it too loud?
A bit hard or a little misleading
